svg.title: Allocate Startup Cash Before Expanding the File Book
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate Startup Cash Before Expanding the File Book; subtitle: Four buckets support $10,000, $30,000, and $75,000 illustrative capital plans.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values encode the $30,000 central planning stack. Bucket details also provide the $10,000 and $75,000 alternatives. Capital plans are separate from the canonical operating scenarios; startup cash is not recognized revenue or automatic annual expense.; caption: Central allocation: $6,000 + $9,000 + $12,000 + $3,000 = $30,000. Alternative stacks total exactly $10,000 and $75,000. A 6–24 month first-deal window requires separate runway planning.; stages: label: Formation and operating readiness; value: Reserve $6,000 centrally for licensing review, insurance, and engagement infrastructure; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Allocate $2,000 in the $10,000 plan and $15,000 in the $75,000 plan: 20% throughout. Budget jurisdiction-specific license and bond costs where required, insurance, entity setup, and counsel-reviewed service documents.; label: Research and workflow systems; value: Reserve $9,000 centrally for lawful data access and dependable case systems; numeric value: 9000.0; detail: Allocate $3,000 in the $10,000 plan and $22,500 in the $75,000 plan: 30% throughout. Fund authorized record retrieval, docket tracking, secure document storage, access controls, and payment-ledger setup.; label: Enforcement working cash; value: Reserve $12,000 centrally for approved operator-borne file costs and delivery; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Allocate $4,000 in the $10,000 plan and $30,000 in the $75,000 plan: 40% throughout. Release cash against matter-level budgets for counsel, filing, service, and contractor delivery. Track creditor advances separately.; label: Liquidity and error reserve; value: Reserve $3,000 centrally for payment interruptions, corrections, and operating contingencies; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Allocate $1,000 in the $10,000 plan and $7,500 in the $75,000 plan: 10% throughout. This is not full launch runway: 6 months at $2,000 monthly consumes $12,000, while 24 months at $12,000 consumes $288,000.
